scope: Frozen training-only silent Nyx discrimination diagnostic with original known-source controls in every grammar; no acoustic playback or acceptance scoring.
hypothesis: At the upstream diagnostic .1 setting, does unchanged HEY NICKS G2P detect the original training sources, and do explicit alternative commands reduce near-word target confusions while both bracket controls succeed?
source_selection: Reuse every one of the original 24 score-independently selected training-only sources, in original order. Prepend reference placement0 and append placement1; no source selection or PCM edits based on scores.
phoneme_policy: Target and alternatives retain original automatic G2P. Only the reference uses its pinned upstream source-defined phonemes. No score-derived phoneme corrections.
grammar_policy: Five-command template capacity requires replacing original contrastive HEY NEXUS with the mandatory reference; retain original first three alternatives in original order. This is a diagnostic, not a matched causal comparison to .9 runs.
quality_gate: All four original-reference cases must emit the correct reference ID (2 or5) before treating any target/miss/confusion result as a functioning-harness diagnosis. Retain failed controls and all outcomes regardless.
accounting_policy: Log every native event and final decoder; check full sample/call coverage and consumed-input CRC including final512-sample zero padding. ID1 is the target in both grammars. Count any ID1 event on each original label0 source as a target false detection; report separately from alternative command detections and exclude known controls from Nyx totals.
limits: The .1 threshold comes from upstream compatibility tests and has no product FAR qualification.
Reused training-only synthetic sources are not independent recall or speaker evidence.
The two bracket controls are correlated placements of one reused recording.
Reset-separated sources are not continuous exposure; no claim of Hi ESP parity.
Standalone MultiNet flash/RAM/CPU is not whole-app fit; preserve production audio and dual OTA.
